svg.title: SQL vs NoSQL: pick by access pattern, not by fashion
svg.desc: Comparison of SQL and NoSQL databases. SQL offers a fixed schema, ACID transactions, joins and flexible querying, scaling primarily through read replicas and vertical growth. NoSQL offers a flexible schema, horizontal scaling by partition key, single digit millisecond lookups at scale, but no joins and usually eventual consistency.
